changes_made.explanation: This paper is about cryptographic decipherment, not natural language generation. The task is decoding/decryption, not generating new text. GPT-2 is used as a language model to score candidate decodings, not to generate text.
Normalized duplicate/redundant metric names to base forms. The paper does use automatic metrics to evaluate the deciphered outputs.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is used in this paper. GPT-2 is used as part of the decipherment algorithm, not as a post-hoc evaluator.

guideline: Annotators were asked to judge whether the system output has the same meaning as the gold-standard plaintext

changes_made.explanation: Normalized criteria to consistent terminology. The paper does conduct human evaluation to assess meaning preservation.

overall_notes: This paper is fundamentally about cryptographic decipherment, not NLG evaluation. While it uses language models and evaluates outputs, the core task is decoding/decryption rather than text generation. The paper should likely not be included in an NLG evaluation survey unless the scope is expanded to include related tasks like machine translation or text reconstruction.
